title: Equipment breakdown - Concrete mixer hydraulic pump failure
description: Mixer stopped during afternoon mortar preparation. Oil pressure loss detected.

title: Cement shortage delay for Tower B masonry
description: Supplier truck delayed by 8 hours due to highway transit check.
resolution: Alternative stock drawn from central depot; truck arrived at 6 PM.

title: Safety concern - Subcontractor workers missing safety harness at Level 14 edge
description: During scaffolding check, 2 workers observed near opening without tie-off harness.

title: Delivery delay of structural bolts
description: Special grade galvanized bolts consignment delayed by vendor.
resolution: Consignment cleared and received on site.
